description_en: Queries the conversation records of the intelligent contact robot
description_zh: 查询智能联络机器人对话记录
name: ListDialog

parameters.help_en: The unique task ID of the robot call task. You can view the ID on the Task Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list) page or obtain it by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/223556.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 机器人呼叫任务的唯一任务ID。在任务管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list)界面查看或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/223556.html接口获取
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The called number. You can view the called number on the Task Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list) > Details page or obtain it by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718009.html operation. The Called parameter returned by the operation is the called number
parameters.help_zh: 被叫号码。在任务管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list)>详情界面查看被叫号码或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718009.html接口获取被叫号码，接口返回的参数**Called**即为被叫号码
parameters.name: called

Code.description_en: The request status code. A value of OK indicates that the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 请求状态码。返回OK代表请求成功

items.description_en: The list of call interaction content

Role.description_en:
The role of the speaker. Valid values:

robot: The speaker is a robot.

user: The speaker is a user
Role.description_zh:
说话的角色。取值：

robot：机器人。

user：用户

Time.description_en: The start time. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds
Time.description_zh: 开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：毫秒

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was called successfully. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
调用接口是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
